strings.subtitle: — Umtshabalalisi weefayile —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ukutsala nokuyeka akufumaneki. Sebenzisa iqhosha elingezantsi.
strings.shred_button: T S H A B A L A L I S A
strings.ssd_warning:
Isilumkiso! Kwi-SSD indlela yokubhala phezulu ayiqinisekisi ukutshatyalaliswa ngenxa ye-TRIM.
Le nkqubo yeye-HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ifayile "{name}" iya kubhalwa phezulu kwaye icinywe.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• Imisinga yedatha engenye ye-NTFS (ADS) ayisetyenzwa.
• Ijenali ye-USN ayicocwa.
• Iikopi zesithunzi kunye nongqamaniso lwamafu
  (OneDrive njl.njl.) azichatshazelwa.
strings.status_full: Umxholo ubhalwe phezulu ngokupheleleyo ngeziro. Ukubuyisela akunakwenzeka — izixhobo ziya kubona iziro kuphela.
strings.status_fast: Intloko, umsila kunye nemigca ye-4 MB ibhalwe phezulu. Okunye akuchatshazelwanga, kodwa ngenxa yezikhewu ukubuyisela okupheleleyo ngezixhobo zomsebenzisi akunakwenzeka. Kumaxwebhu afihlakeleyo sebenzisa imowudi EPHELELEYO.
strings.status_empty: Ifayile yayingenanto, ukubhala phezulu kwakungafuneki. Icinyiwe.
strings.error_permission: Andikwazi ukufikelela kwifayile. Inokuba ivuliwe kwenye inkqubo. Yivale kwaye uzame kwakhona.
strings.error_is_symlink: Esi sisixhumanisi somfuziselo. Izixhumanisi azinakutshatyalaliswa — ifayile ekujoliswe kuyo iya kuhlala ikhuselekile.
strings.error_reparse: Le yifayile yendawo (OneDrive okanye efanayo). Idatha yayo isefini, hayi kwidiski — akukho nto inokutshatyalaliswa apha.
strings.error_not_file: Le ayiyofayile (ifolda okanye enye into). Yeka ifayile.
strings.error_hardlinks: Le fayile inezinye iikhonkco eziqinileyo ({n} zizonke). Iikhonkco eziqinileyo azinamandla aphambili — onke amagama ayalingana. Ukuba utshabalalisa ngendlela yangoku, idatha iya kubhalwa phezulu kwaye incitshiswe kwii-32 byte, kodwa okuseleyo kuya kuhlala kufikeleleka ngezinye iikhonkco. Cima zonke iikhonkco kuqala.
strings.error_compressed:
Ifayile icinezelwe, ifihliwe okanye incinci. Ukubhala phezulu ngeziro akuqinisekisi ukutshatyalaliswa kwedatha yakudala kuba i-NTFS iyigcina ngendlela eyahlukileyo.

Susa uphawu: cofa ekunene → Iimpawu → Ezithe xhaxhe → susa uphawu lwe-"Cinezela" kunye/okanye "Fihla". Emva koko qhuba i-SHREDDER kwakhona.
